As a technology leader that is rapidly on the move, HARMAN is filled with people who are focused on making life better. Innovation, inclusivity and teamwork are a part of our DNA.

When you add that to the challenges we take on and solve together, you’ll discover that at HARMAN you can grow, make a difference and be proud of the work you do every day. About the Role The Director, Cost Engineering & Sustainability defines and executes cost and sustainability engineering strategy across HARMAN's Automotive division.

The created strategy is used to define overall profitability, sustainability, and growth goals for HARMAN AUTOMOTIVE.

The role is responsible for reaching the defined goals by driving cross-functional implementation of Technical and Commercial measures in collaboration with, mainly but not exclusively with, Procurement, Engineering, Customer Account Management, Manufacturing, and Suppliers.

The role is responsible for optimizing a multibillion-dollar spend and is expected to deliver benchmark performance & defined sustainability goals over multiple years to enable divisional-level growth results. The role reports into Best Cost Analytics in the Strategic Procurement and Partnering Function of our global Operations.

Your Team This position will report to the VP, Best Cost Analytics lead, and will have a global team of 15 direct reports, leading cost improvement strategy and execution from multiple stakeholder groups. What You Will Do
Establish the vision, goal, framework, processes, and methods needed to enable profitability, sustainability, and growth goals with highly accurate cost/ CO2e modeling (TCO) across the entire HARMAN Automotive division (all products, regions, and customers)
Establish the vision for Lifecycle Assessment of emissions (CO2e) and build capabilities to achieve carbon neutrality per Harman Automotive Sustainability objectives
Define divisional profitability, sustainability goal, and execution strategy in respective areas (see above) with senior leadership of the division
Develop, align, and execute division-wide strategy to assemble and enable highly effective cross-functional teams, including Procurement, Engineering, Manufacturing, and Account Management, which create overarching profitability, sustainability strategies, and deliver commercial and technical measures.
Build and enroll strategy with the executive leadership team of HARMAN and Suppliers to identify a framework for reaching cost transparency and the best cost that ensures HARMAN's overall competitiveness in the market.
Support the Make versus buy analysis process for Controlling, category, and the Operations organization
Define and deliver advanced sourcing, design to cost, CO2e reduction & manufacturing and sourcing strategy of current and new HARMAN products in close collaboration with state-of-the-art supply chain partners
Create and execute a supplier and customer cost negotiation strategy with Procurement and Customer Account teams
Ensure day-to-day development and delivery of cost & CO2e models by establishing required processes and methods to drive consistent practices within the cost engineering team and reflecting industry best practices. This includes the processes necessary to keep the cost & CO2e models up to date with current information and best known methods.
Develop synergy programs within the Samsung group to leverage scale in business
Lead Component Engineering effort across the Division to create a component library that meets HARMAN Automotive’s long-term product strategy, profitability, sustainability, and growth
Build a development strategy of internal teams to reach a cost-conscious mindset across all teams of the Automotive division
Lead, Coach, and Develop staff and through training and succession planning processes to maximize their potential for the benefit of the individual and company
